mapper.select: SELECT id, name, cur_location, ROUND( ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT( CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(cur_location, ',', 1) AS DECIMAL(10,7)), -- 经度 CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(cur_location, ',', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,7)) -- 纬度 ), POINT(116.407395, 39.904211) -- 商家坐标（示例） ) ) AS distance_in_meters FROM tb_courier WHERE on_job = 1 AND cur_location IS NOT NULL AND cur_location LIKE '%,%' AND ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT( CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(cur_location, ',', 1) AS DECIMAL(10,7)), CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(cur_location, ',', -1) AS DECIMAL(10,7)) ), POINT(116.407395, 39.904211) ) < 10000; -- 10公里内
